articles.title_en: Officer Lis: the first detachments of the Russian Armed Forces entered the outskirts of Alekseevo-Druzhkovka

articles.title_en: FSB says it detained a woman in Moscow on suspicion of working for Ukrainian intelligence. It says she plotted to blow up a security officer’s car.
articles.lead_en: Russia’s Federal Security Service detained a Russian woman born in 1996 in Moscow, accusing her of trying to bomb a security officer’s car on assignment from Ukrainian intelligence, the FSB’s Public Relations Center announced.

articles.title_en: Ukraine launches one of its biggest strikes on Russia this year, targeting Wildberries warehouses and a missile plant
articles.lead_en: Russia’s air defenses shot down 571 Ukrainian drones overnight on July 24 over 15 regions of Russia, occupied Crimea, and the Sea of Azov and Black Sea, the Defense Ministry reported.
